5. Reporting Requirements - The permittee shall report annually on the DMR the following

candidates.computation_change_reason: Which Element II, Section I.D. frequency applies to the permittee determines whether monitoring was required for each FY2025 period and whether absence of results indicates non-applicability or missing evidence.
